data.long_meaning: From the Old English word 'wad' meaning a valley or a low-lying piece of land. The name Wade can be interpreted as a traveller or someone who journeys through a valley or a low-lying area. The name Wade carries the meaning “Valley traveller” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wade usually hope their child will grow to embody valley traveller and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ουέιντ

in_latin.name: Wade
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Wade originem habet in verbo Anglico antiquo 'wæd', quod significat 'vadum' vel 'transitus'. Hoc nomen coniungitur cum transitu fluminum vel marium et potest habere significationem spiritualem de transitu vel mutatione in vita.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Wade originates from the Old English word 'wæd', meaning 'to cross or ford a river'. It symbolizes journeying through life's challenges and spiritual growth. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, it reflects themes of transition and perseverance found in Christian tradition. Historically, it has been used in various Christian cultures, signifying a path of faith and determination.
